enchantment.minecraft_mode.aquaminer.des: Mines faster underwater; level IV mines as fast as on land.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.auto_smelt.de: Block drops come out smelted. Incompatible with Silk Touch. Pickaxes only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.barrage.desc: Fires two extra bolts per level. Incompatible with Multishot and Piercing.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.berserk.desc: 10% chance per level on hit to gain Strength I for 3 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.bleeding_edge: Melee hits make the target bleed for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.bulwark_strik: 8% chance per level on hit to gain Absorption I for 5 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.cleave.desc: Melee hits also deal 20% of the damage per level to enemies within 2.5 blocks.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.coin_finder.d: Mining an ore has a 12% chance per level to drop copper coins.
15% chance per level not to use up an arrow.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.ember.desc: Sets the target on fire for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.enfeeble.desc: Melee hits weaken the target for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.excavation.de: Mines a 3x3 (I) or 5x5 (II) area facing you. Incompatible with Vein Miner.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.explosive_arr: Arrows explode on hit (radius 1.5-2.5). Never breaks blocks.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.explosive_bol: Bolts explode on hit (radius 1.5-2.5). Never breaks blocks.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.flash_bolt.de: Bolts blind the target for 2-6 seconds and make it glow.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.focus.desc: +0.5 block and entity reach per level. Helmets only.
Nearby players gain +1 Luck per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.frost_arrow.d: Arrows slow the target; longer and stronger with each level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.frostbite.des: Melee hits slow the target; longer and stronger with each level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.gale_arrow.de: Arrows lift the target into the air (Levitation for 1-3 seconds).
enchantment.minecraft_mode.guardian_aura: Nearby players gain +1 armor per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.guillotine.de: 5% chance per level for zombies, skeletons, creepers and piglins to drop their head (wither skeletons 2%).
enchantment.minecraft_mode.haste.desc: +20% mining speed per level. Leggings only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.incendiary_bo: Bolts fly burning and set the target on fire for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.leap.desc: +10% jump strength and +1 safe fall distance per level. Boots only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.leap_aura.des: Nearby players jump 10% higher per level and gain +1 safe fall distance per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.lifesteal.des: Melee hits grant Regeneration II for 1.5-3.5 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.lucky_charm.d: +1 Luck per level (better loot from chests and fishing). Helmets only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.magnet.desc: Block drops go straight into your inventory.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.mining_aura.d: Nearby players mine 20% faster per level. Does not stack with other Auras of Haste.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.mining_moment: Breaking a block grants Haste (same level) for 2 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.momentum.desc: Melee hits grant Speed I for 2-6 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.night_sight.d: Brightens darkness by 20% per level; level V sees at night like in daylight. Helmets only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.piercing_shot: Arrows pass through one extra enemy per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.plunder.desc: Hostile mobs you kill drop up to one extra copper coin per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.quick_draw.de: Draws the bow 25% faster per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.raider_bane.d: +2.5 damage per level against illagers, witches and ravagers.
Reloads 0.2 seconds faster per level. Incompatible with Quick Charge.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.regeneration_: Nearby players heal 0.5 health per level every 3 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.reinforced_bo: Bolts deal +1 flat damage per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.resilience.de: +1 armor toughness per level. Leggings only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.satiation_aur: Nearby players regain 1 hunger per level every 10 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.searing.desc: +1.5 damage per level against burning targets.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.self_repair.d: Repairs 1 durability per level every 2 seconds while carried. Incompatible with Mending.
Arrows deal +1 flat damage per level (stacks with Power).
Mobs drop 50% more experience per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.steadfast.des: +10% knockback resistance per level. Leggings only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.strength.desc: +1 attack damage per level. Chestplates only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.strength_aura: Nearby players deal +1 attack damage per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.stun.desc: 6% chance per level to stun the target (Slowness V and Mining Fatigue III) for 1.5 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.sunder.desc: Ignores 10% of the target's armor per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.swift_step.de: +10% movement speed per level. Boots only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.swiftness_aur: Nearby players move 5% faster per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.thrift.desc: 15% chance per level not to use up ammunition when loading.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.thunder_arrow: 10% chance per level to call lightning on a target under the open sky.
12% chance per level to call lightning on a target under the open sky.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.timber.desc: Chopping a log fells up to 16 connected logs per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.toughness_aur: Nearby players gain +1 armor toughness per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.treasure_hunt: Mining stone has a 1% chance per level to unearth a treasure.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.vein_miner.de: Mining an ore also mines up to 4 connected ores of the same kind per level. Pickaxes only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.venom.desc: Melee hits poison the target for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.venom_arrow.d: Arrows poison the target for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.vitality.desc: +2 max health (one heart) per level. Chestplates only.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.vitality_aura: Nearby players gain +2 max health per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.volley.desc: Fires one extra arrow per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.wisdom.desc: Blocks drop 50% more experience per level.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.withering_bla: Melee hits wither the target for 3-7 seconds.
enchantment.minecraft_mode.withering_bol: Bolts wither the target for 3-7 seconds.
